name: Aroha Kōwhai
bio:
Aroha Kōwhai's journey into motorsport wasn't exactly linear. Growing up in a small town in New Zealand, her initial passion was engineering, fuelled by taking apart and rebuilding anything with an engine. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, she took a role working in a factory. But the roar of the engines at a local rally event ignited a different fire. She quickly transitioned into motorsport, starting as a junior mechanic, then moving on to race engineer. She's worked her way up the ranks with Inter Europol, demonstrating sharp leadership. 

As Head of Operations, Aroha focuses on ensuring that every department is working in sync, from logistics to engineering. She believes in empowering her team and fostering a collaborative environment where everyone feels valued. Her perfectionist tendencies, while occasionally challenging, ensure that no detail is overlooked, and that the team is always prepared for the unexpected.

physical.hairStyle: Long, thick hair usually tied back in a practical braid.
physical.description: Aroha has a strong, athletic build with a focused gaze that inspires confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn copy of a mechanical engineering textbook.
Has a habit of sketching out technical diagrams on napkins during meetings.
Insists on a pre-race karakia (Māori prayer) for the team's safety and success.
